I am renting this small plot here in Mwanza, only about half a hectare, and I grow rice to feed my family and sell a little at the market. I have no schooling and very little money, so I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer — maybe I will buy one small bag of urea if the price is not too high, and I will put some cow manure I collect from my neighbor's cattle. I use the seed I saved from last season because improved seed is expensive and the agro-dealer is far. My wife and older children help me in the field, and during transplanting and harvest I will hire a few people from the village to finish in time.
